overview: Fast-dLLM v2 adapts pretrained autoregressive LLMs into efficient block diffusion models via a novel training recipe with complementary masking and block-wise attention, combined with a hierarchical caching and parallel decoding inference strategy to achieve significant speedup without quality loss.

modules.name: Configuration Management
modules.description: Centralizes the management of all hyperparameters and configurations, including block size, sub-block size, training steps, learning rates, confidence thresholds, and distributed training settings, ensuring consistency across data processing, training, and inference phases.

modules.name: Data Preprocessing & Block-Aligned Packing
modules.description: Handles the tokenization and structural preparation of training data. It implements sequence padding to ensure lengths are multiples of the block size, concatenation of sequences into a long token stream, and splitting into fixed context lengths to guarantee block boundaries do not cross sample boundaries.

modules.name: Masking Strategy & Complementary Views
modules.description: Implements the sampling of random binary masks for intra-block masking and generates complementary views (m and 1-m) for each training sample. This ensures that all tokens within a block receive supervision in both masked and visible contexts within the same batch.

modules.name: Block-Wise Attention Masking & Flex-Attention
modules.description: Constructs the hybrid attention mask required for the block diffusion architecture, combining Block Diagonal (intra-block bidirectional), Offset Block Causal (cross-block dependency), and Block Causal (left-to-right causality) patterns. It also integrates Flex-Attention for efficient hardware utilization.

modules.name: Model Architecture Adaptation (Token Shift)
modules.description: Modifies the standard Transformer decoder to support the shifted-label prediction strategy, where the prediction for a masked token at position i is computed using the hidden state from its preceding position (i-1), thereby preserving the autoregressive representation quality.

modules.name: Training Objective & Loss Computation
modules.description: Implements the masked-token-only cross-entropy loss function. It handles the calculation of loss exclusively for masked tokens while leveraging the complementary masking strategy to ensure consistent normalization across the full sequence length.

modules.name: Distributed Training Workflow
modules.description: Sets up the distributed training environment using DeepSpeed Zero-3. It configures the AdamW optimizer, implements linear learning rate warmup and scheduling, and manages the overall training loop for fine-tuning the pretrained models.

modules.name: Block-Level KV Caching for Inference
modules.description: Implements the inter-block caching mechanism where unmasked tokens from previously decoded blocks are stored as read-only Key-Value caches. This allows subsequent blocks to attend to historical context without redundant computation.

modules.name: Sub-Block DualCache Mechanism
modules.description: Implements the hierarchical sub-block caching strategy (DualCache) for intra-block decoding. It maintains both prefix and suffix KV caches to enable efficient recomputation and reuse as additional tokens are revealed during the refinement process.

modules.name: Confidence-Aware Parallel Decoding Strategy
modules.description: Implements the iterative refinement algorithm for inference. It evaluates the model's confidence for predicted tokens, finalizes tokens exceeding the confidence threshold in parallel, and retains uncertain positions as masked for future refinement steps.

modules.name: Inference Pipeline & Batch Scheduling
modules.description: Orchestrates the block-by-block generation process, integrating block-level caching, sub-block DualCache, and parallel decoding. It handles variable-length sequences by right-padding with mask tokens to align with block sizes and manages efficient batch scheduling on hardware.

modules.name: Evaluation Suite - Reasoning & Knowledge
modules.description: Integrates the LM-Eval framework to evaluate the model on knowledge-intensive and reasoning benchmarks such as GSM8K, MATH, MMLU, GPQA, and IFEval, calculating accuracy and other relevant metrics under zero-shot or few-shot settings.

modules.name: Evaluation Suite - Code Generation
modules.description: Integrates the EvalPlus framework to rigorously evaluate code generation capabilities on HumanEval and MBPP benchmarks, computing Base and Plus pass rates to assess functional correctness.

modules.name: Efficiency & Throughput Benchmarking
modules.description: Measures and compares computational efficiency metrics, including generation latency, throughput (tokens/sec), and memory usage across different batch sizes, context lengths, and hardware configurations (e.g., A100 vs H100).

modules.name: Ablation & Component Analysis
modules.description: Provides the framework for conducting ablation studies to validate design choices. It supports experiments varying token shift strategies, complementary masking effects, block sizes, sub-block sizes, and caching mechanisms to analyze their impact on accuracy and speed.
